Ready for a Change?

You’ve come to the right place. Our free in-home bathroom design consultations in Maine, high-end product selections, fast demos, and professional installation will take you from design to done in no time–and with no stress.

Full Bathroom Remodels

Our full bathroom remodel offers a seamless renovation process, replacing old fixtures with stylish, high-quality options. Enjoy a stress-free experience with our reliable team, fixed timelines, and no surprise costs, adding comfort, style, and value to your home.

Accessible Bathroom Remodels

Our accessible bathroom remodels provide stylish safety with ADA-compliant walk-in tubs and showers. Enjoy features like grab bars, slip-resistant flooring, and comfortable seats, all seamlessly integrated into a beautiful bathroom design for your comfort and peace of mind.

Meet Portland’s best full-service bathroom remodeling company

At Re-Bath in Portland, Maine, our experienced bathroom remodelers are dedicated to delivering high-quality bathroom renovations that meet your specific needs. Unlike companies that promise a “bathroom in a day,” we take a more personalized approach, collaborating with you to design a bathroom that suits your vision while staying within your budget. We offer transparent, one-price quotes for every project, ensuring there are no surprises unless we encounter structural issues, mold, or termite damage.

Why Choose Re-Bath?

Our goal is to provide a full-service remodeling experience that makes the process as easy and stress-free as possible. We employ certified, professional installers who only use products we trust. With exclusive access to Re-Bath’s premium products—many of which are manufactured in the U.S.—we offer a lifetime warranty on our work, giving you peace of mind. Our specialized sealant ensures durability, allowing our wall systems to expand and contract with temperature changes.

In addition to our remodeling services, we offer an aftercare program to provide ongoing support after the project is complete. Our licensed and fully insured contractors focus on the details and can typically complete most projects within three to five days. When you choose us, you can expect:

  • Effortless and hassle-free services
  • Creative, functional design ideas
  • Friendly, professional contractors who prioritize your satisfaction

Whether you want to update your entire bathroom or need modifications for aging-in-place or accessibility, we’re here to help. We can work with your existing layout and offer cost-effective remodeling solutions that enhance both the functionality and beauty of your space. Re-Bath stands apart from other bathroom remodeling companies, and we are committed to earning your trust and loyalty through excellent service and exceptional results.

Committed to Accessibility and Safety

Re-Bath is a trusted brand with over 1 million bathrooms remodeled across the country. We’re well-versed in ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) standards and ensure our projects are fully compliant with all necessary codes. Our dedication to quality has earned us top ratings from both the Better Business Bureau and Consumer Affairs.

At Re-Bath Portland, we strive to create bathrooms that are safe, accessible, and comfortable for daily use. Our team will treat your home with respect and carefully review all your remodeling options before starting. Call us today, and let’s discuss how we can transform your bathroom into the space you’ve always wanted!
